arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/final_check.sh << 'EOF'
set -e
cd /workspace
echo "== public check =="
python3 public_check.py submission/gateway.py
echo "== unit suites =="
for t in t1 t2 t3 t5 t6; do printf "%-4s " $t; python3 tmp/$t.py 2>&1 | tail -1; done
echo "== fuzz =="
timeout 900 python3 tmp/fuzz.py
echo "== perf =="
python3 tmp/perf.py 2>&1 | grep -E "time|exit"
echo "== constraints =="
python3 - << 'PY'
import os, stat
p = "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"
st = os.lstat(p)
assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode), "not a regular file"
assert not os.path.islink(p), "is a symlink"
assert st.st_size <= 256*1024, "too big"
entries = sorted(os.listdir("/workspace/submission"))
assert entries == ["gateway.py"], entries
import ast
tree = ast.parse(open(p).read())
print("ok: regular file %d bytes, only gateway.py in submission/" % st.st_size)
PY
EOF
bash /tmp/final_check.sh
